reasons: Datadog avg:nginx.net.request_per_s{*} averages the per-second request rate across all series, but the candidate sums rate(nginx.requests) across all series, so the reported value is multiplied by the number of series.
The Datadog metric is already a per-second rate, and nginx.requests is a monotonic sum, so rate() over it matches the quantity and unit.
An exact translation exists (avg instead of sum over the rate), so translated is the correct outcome, but the aggregation in the candidate is wrong.
The template variable $Host is not referenced by the query ({*}), so omitting a host matcher is correct.
